scope.question: Can PMXT tick_size_change rows be represented in NT catalog/backtest without custom simulation behavior?
scope.answer: Pinned NT has live Polymarket tick-size-change handling, catalog support for multiple InstrumentAny snapshots, and BacktestDataConfig support for InstrumentStatus/InstrumentClose auxiliary streams. Standard BacktestNode catalog replay does not provide timed InstrumentAny replay: BacktestNode queries instruments up front, adds them before market data, BacktestDataConfig/NautilusDataType does not include InstrumentAny, BacktestEngine::add_data accepts Vec<Data>, and Data has no InstrumentAny variant. Multiple up-front snapshots for one instrument id collapse through cache/exchange insertion instead of replaying timestamped epochs. Full dynamic tick-size replay therefore requires a separate approved timed instrument-epoch path, not ordinary BacktestDataConfig catalog replay.

nt_live_semantics_evidence.finding: Pinned NT live PolymarketDataClient handles MarketWsMessage::TickSizeChange as a distinct message.
No-op tick_size_change messages are ignored when the existing instrument already has the new price increment.
Pinned NT live handling calls rebuild_instrument_with_tick_size and emits DataEvent::Instrument for the rebuilt instrument.
For book subscriptions, a tick-size change starts a book epoch transition and requires a fresh snapshot before book deltas resume.
rebuild_instrument_with_tick_size preserves BinaryOption fields and changes price_precision and price_increment from the new tick size.

nt_catalog_backtest_evidence.finding: ParquetDataCatalog::write_instruments can write InstrumentAny snapshots grouped by instrument id and timestamp interval.
query_instruments_filtered reads matching instrument parquet files, optionally filters by ts_init, and sorts returned instruments by ts_init.
BacktestNode calls query_instruments, which delegates to query_instruments_filtered with no start/end timestamp bounds.
BacktestNode queries catalog instruments before loading market data and adds them to the engine up front.
NautilusDataType enumerates replayable BacktestDataConfig data classes and does not include InstrumentAny.
The standard Data enum includes InstrumentStatus and InstrumentClose but not InstrumentAny instrument-definition updates.
BacktestDataConfig dispatches market data classes including InstrumentStatus and InstrumentClose, but not InstrumentAny.
BacktestNode loads catalog query results into BacktestEngine::add_data; this path accepts Vec<Data>, not InstrumentAny snapshots.
BacktestEngine::add_data stores replay data as Data enum items in the data iterator.
NT DataEngine::process can handle dynamically typed InstrumentAny for live-style instrument events, but that is a separate path from BacktestDataConfig catalog replay.
BacktestEngine::add_instrument applies InstrumentAny to the exchange and data engine when called directly, but BacktestDataConfig does not schedule this call at a timestamp.
SimulatedExchange::add_instrument inserts by instrument id; multiple up-front snapshots for one id can overwrite rather than replaying a timed epoch unless proven otherwise.
Cache::add_instrument inserts by instrument id, so repeated up-front InstrumentAny snapshots for one id retain only one current instrument in the cache.
Live DataEvent::Instrument carries InstrumentAny separately from Data; this reinforces that instrument definitions are not replayable BacktestDataConfig Data items in the pinned path.

bte_manifest_surface_evidence: BTE now maps NT InstrumentStatus and InstrumentClose BacktestDataConfig classes as auxiliary catalog streams for TradeReplay and L2Replay.
InstrumentStatus and InstrumentClose are Data enum replay items, not InstrumentAny instrument-definition updates, so this does not close tick_size_change epoch replay.
The branch adds regression coverage that auxiliary InstrumentStatus/InstrumentClose inputs cannot satisfy TradeReplay without a primary TradeTick; PR CI is the broad gate for this commit.

compile_checked_bte_surface_proof.decision: The BTE proof crate can compile against NT live tick-size change message and rebuild surfaces, and can compile against BacktestDataConfig auxiliary InstrumentStatus/InstrumentClose streams, but pinned NT exposes no BacktestDataConfig InstrumentAny stream. Standard BacktestNode catalog replay must not be used to claim dynamic instrument-epoch replay.

policy_implications.reason: Pinned NT live handling treats real tick-size changes as instrument epoch transitions and waits for a fresh snapshot before resuming book deltas.
BacktestNode loads InstrumentAny snapshots before market data, then streams Vec<Data> through BacktestEngine::add_data. The standard Data enum has no InstrumentAny variant.
ParquetDataCatalog can store multiple InstrumentAny snapshots, but standard BacktestNode catalog replay preloads instruments instead of applying them as timestamped Data.

A bounded proof can choose an unaffected instrument universe to prove OrderBookDelta/TradeTick catalog plumbing, but this cannot close full PMXT Polymarket L2 source acceptance. The selected-source projection schema now rejects any config that tries to put tick_size_change in ignored_event_types.
It would apply post-change price precision and price increment before the source event that changed them.

required_green_tests_when_implementation: Write and query multiple BinaryOption snapshots for one instrument id through ParquetDataCatalog and prove returned order/ts_init.

If dynamic tick-size inclusion is attempted, prove a separate explicitly approved timed InstrumentAny replay mechanism; ordinary BacktestDataConfig InstrumentStatus/InstrumentClose auxiliary streams are not sufficient evidence.
If first proof excludes tick-changing assets, assert the exclusion is source-proof-bound and appears as a result-contract claim limit.
If tick-size changes are included, prove post-change book deltas are not consumed until a source snapshot rebuilds the book epoch.

RED rust_verification cargo test --test backtesting_vertical_slice_pmxt_one_off_projection pmxt_selected_source_projection_rejects_ignored_tick_size_change_rows failed because tick_size_change in ignored_event_types was silently skipped.

GREEN rust_verification cargo test --test backtesting_vertical_slice_pmxt_one_off_projection pmxt_selected_source_projection_rejects_ignored_tick_size_change_rows passed after the selected-source schema rejected ignored_event_types that overlap forbidden_ignored_event_types.

current_decision.next_required_evidence: For full L2 acceptance, either accept a source-proof-bound no-tick-size-change universe with explicit claim limits, or implement and prove a separate approved timed InstrumentAny replay mechanism. The configured first-proof selector, NT catalog read-back, and BacktestNode run over selected unaffected instruments are bounded one-off evidence only; standard BacktestNode catalog replay must not be used to claim dynamic tick-size replay.
